explication: Kai is a cross-platform AI assistant centered on a chat loop: the user sends a message, Kai assembles a prompt with persistent memories, calls a configured AI service, executes requested tools, and returns the response while retaining conversation state. Separate capabilities include local inference, generated interactive UI, autonomous heartbeat, skills/MCP, and Android Linux sandboxing. Workflow details follow the README; source excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
